## Description

What changed and why.

## Checklist

- [ ] Ruff (`ruff check src/ tests/`) passes
- [ ] Mypy (`mypy`) passes
- [ ] Pytest (`pytest`) passes
- [ ] New or updated tests cover the change
- [ ] README or docstrings updated if the public API or CLI changed
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry added under `[Unreleased]` for user-facing changes
- [ ] Commit messages follow the convention in `CONTRIBUTING.md`
